review_scope: Read-only verification of terminal saved results, registered roster and saved model parameters; no raw source cache reads and no model execution.
independent_memory_check: Reconstructed observed velocities from saved acceleration and causal/reset states; independently integrated each constant-rate memory using a five-state matrix exponential including work moments. No production memory-integral helper was used.
claim_boundary: Stage A is descriptive observed-path accounting. Engineering verification does not establish proposed-model predictive effect, identifiability, stability certification or promotion. Scientific_pass=false is retained.
review_limits: Saved witness/window bounds were checked; raw threshold crossings and angle extrema were not rederived because original equilibrium arrays were not reread.
Nonzero physical momentum and kinetic residuals remain diagnostic values; only accounting and memory identities were checked against zero.
